title: Ornate Musical Pendant
description: A highly detailed circular pendant hangs from a braided red and black cord with gold accents. The pendant features a dark red orb with golden musical notes, surrounded by purple gemstones, red liquid droplets, and a black triangular element at the bottom.
prompt: A highly detailed ornate circular pendant made of dark metal with intricate gold filigree, centered around a glowing deep red orb containing floating golden musical notes and staves, surrounded by several purple gemstones, red liquid droplets dripping from the top, and a black triangular gem at the bottom right, hanging from a thick braided red and black cord with small gold medallions, dramatic lighting against a dark blue background, fantasy style, intricate details
